description:
Embark into Zul'Gurub at an increased difficulty! Bosses and creatures alike have become tougher than before, now boasting increased physical damage, increased magic damage and increased health, making every encounter more challenging to overcome than before!

Defeat Hakkar and claim many rewards: from Marks of Ascension, Triumphant Raider Tokens, and unique cosmetics!
name: Raid Trial - Zul'Gurub
